# Notes for App Review (2.1.0)

- AI reflections are generated by OpenAI through our own server. Both the entry and the reflection pass OpenAI moderation. Users give consent on first launch and can withdraw it in Settings.
- The app uses expo-updates (EAS Update) only for bug fixes to JavaScript. Updates do not add features or change content rules; any feature change ships as a new App Store version.
- A remote setting can pause AI reflections during an outage. It can only turn the feature off.
- Sign in with Apple; account deletion is under Settings > Delete account.
